During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''friend''' of [[Dasha Defano]]'s was traveling on a civilian [[Transport/Legends|transport]] when it was attacked by [[Unidentified Wroonian privateer band|privateers]]. The band destroyed the transport to stop it sending out a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]]. Defano, who was a member of the [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]], learned of her friends' [[Death/Legends|death]] and was ashamed that she was part of the actions that had led to it. She left the privateers, and joined the Rebel Alliance. Defano carried a [[Hologram/Legends|holo-image]] of her friend in her gear bag.
